summary.goal: Allow users to spawn/connect an AI planning agent for any existing plan, not just at plan creation time
summary.context: Currently, AI agents are only spawned when creating a new plan with ai_assist=true. If a user opens an existing plan (session expired or never had one), they're stuck in 'Demo Mode' with mock responses. Users need a way to start a real AI session on any plan they're editing.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /plans/:id/session endpoint spawns a planning agent for an existing plan
UI shows 'Connect AI' button when viewing a draft plan without an active session
Clicking 'Connect AI' spawns agent and transitions from Demo Mode to Connected
If plan already has active session, endpoint returns existing session info (409)
Spawned agent has full plan context (goal, step count, instructed to read current state)
Connection status indicator updates in real-time after connecting
Only draft plans can have AI sessions (approved/published plans stay in demo mode)

out_of_scope: Auto-spawn on first chat message (could be added later)
